prompt: A parallelogram-shaped tile has a base of $12$ cm and a height of $7$ cm. What is its area, in square centimeters?
hint: Area of a parallelogram is base times height — no halving.

hints.text: Area of a parallelogram is base times height — no halving.

alternativeExplanations.title: Slide the triangle over
steps: Cut the slanted triangle off one end of the parallelogram and slide it to the other end.
You now have a $12$-by-$7$ rectangle with the same area: $84$ sq cm. That is why the formula matches a rectangle's.
